reader: read.py <run>  (smallest slack per mark count, Word | engine; probes are the K x digits grid in generate.py)
word: Word 16.114, compat 15, compressPunctuation, w:lang eastAsia zh-CN (without zh-CN the marks keep their em): a justified line squeezes its fullwidth marks to keep one more character

n marks give up n/(n+1) em together, not n halves: smallest slack a (pt) per n marks at 12pt is 6, 4, 3, 2.4, 2 (a >= 12/(n+1)); position of the marks does not matter, shorter lines allow slightly more
A digit between ideographs lets its two 3pt auto-space gaps give up about 2pt each (a 31-unit line with one digit fits at 10pt of slack); they join the n in n/(n+1)
Does not squeeze: closing quote and opening quote in this probe
